we have developed a novel deep learning framework for omics, OmicsCNN, which can be used to predict the phenotype of patients from their microbiota, and which has been applied to a real world dataset of IBD.

(i) a novel Keras OmicsConv layer is introduced to enable convolutional neural networks on metrizable omics data, and (ii) a novel OmicsCNN framework is introduced, based on a novel OmicsConv layer, for metrizable omic data.

In summary, our research is concerned with

the definition of a novel deep learning framework to predict omics data, based on a novel Keras convolutional layer, the OmicsConv, and the OmicsCNN deep learning architecture, and its application to the prediction of IBD.
the development of OmicsCNN, an OmicsConv layer for convolutional neural networks, and its application on metagenomics and transcriptomics data.
a new deep learning framework, OmicsCNN, that is able to learn from omics data.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed OmicsConv layer and OmicsCNN framework are a novel and general approach to deep learning on omics data.

the proposed OmicsCNN architecture, implemented through the OmicsConv Keras layer, is able to predict the IBD status with high accuracy, even when using a very small number of training samples, i.e., 10, and with a very low number of training epochs, i.e., less than 100.
OmicsCNN is an efficient deep learning architecture that can be applied on metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data, and that is able to learn complex patterns in a supervised learning setting.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose OmicsConv, which is a general layer to be applied to different omics datasets, and OmicsCNN, which is a specific deep learning architecture to be applied to metagenomics datasets, in particular for gut microbiota data.
OmicsCNN is a new tool for omics data, that can be used on different data types and that can be applied to different tasks.
we have developed a deep learning tool to analyze omics data.

OmicsCNN is a powerful tool that can be applied to any omics data that can be endowed with some distance function.
